note: Re-judged 2026-11-08 (independent auditor) after 79e3205310, 0cf6ed47ad, 4e987c42f3 and b6b327852c changed config.go::ExtractParameters (realm relay and proxy-lcp validation) and reactor_dial.go::handleDial (a call to a remote with a connecting or established tunnel joins that tunnel's queue, pendingCall became pendingCalls). No changed line touches the retransmit budget: ExtractParameters still parses it, and a new tunnel handleDial creates still takes r.reliableConfig(); the joining paths create no tunnel. Verdict stands. Prior judgement: Rejudged after the RFC 791 Section 3.2 and RFC 5072 Section 2 comment was added inside ExtractParameters before its existing validateMRUNCP call. The diff changes no executable statement, configuration value, test or tag. RFC 2661 Section 5.8 states: "If no peer response is detected after several retransmissions, (a recommended default is 5, but SHOULD be configurable), the tunnel and all sessions within MUST be cleared." This RID owns the configurable-budget SHOULD; RFC2661-5.8-3 separately owns the MUST-clear obligation. Q1 yes: TestRFC2661ConfiguredMaxRetransmitClearsTunnel selects budget 2 before the incoming tunnel is constructed, establishes it, leaves its HELLO unanswered, asserts Established after each of the two allowed retransmissions, then requires Closed and the StopCCN log at the next deadline. This tests a configured count differing from the default 5. Q2 yes by the assertions: ignoring 2 in favor of 5 misses the final Closed assertion, while early exhaustion misses an Established assertion. The existing reliableConfig panic records demonstrate reachability only; this static rejudgment claims no newly observed semantic red. Q3 yes: hello-retries 0 disables competing dead-peer detection, the fixture creates no tunnel timer, and its controlled clock advances past the exponential retransmission deadlines after a completed tunnel handshake. Q4 yes for the complete configurable-budget obligation: TestConfig_MaxRetransmit separately asserts default 5 and parsed explicit 9; TestReloadAppliesMaxRetransmit asserts parsed 8 reaches subsystem and reactor defaults. ExtractParameters still defaults and parses MaxRetransmit and its valid configurations pass the unchanged MRU check. tunnelDefaults carries the value; setMaxRetransmit updates future tunnel defaults; reliableConfig feeds both locateTunnelLocked and handleDial. newTunnel and NewReliableEngine preserve a nonzero selected count, Tick signals teardown only when attempts exceed it, and handleTick consumes that signal through teardownStopCCN. The positive and negative tags cover final exhaustion and preservation before exhaustion, respectively; the separate session-clearing MUST is not claimed from this configurable-count test. No new implementation or coverage defect was found in this scoped audit. No test, build, recorder or stamp was run by this auditor.
